info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of job applications submitted through the careers portal. This endpoint serves as a pivotal resource for applicants seeking insights into their application progress, facilitating transparency and enhancing user engagement. Typically utilized by job seekers and recruiters, it helps in monitoring application lifecycle events and improving recruitment efficiency. By providing real-time status updates, this API empowers users to make informed decisions throughout their job search process.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the status of all applications. It provides insight into their current state, allowing for better application management and user experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of applications. It includes the necessary parameters formatted in JSON to specify what status information is being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the current application status is returned.
